connector: I-PEX MHF I (U.FL compatible per p7 drawing)
band_table_caveat: Listed bands have ticks for all three tested cable directions; band 71 is right/straight only. Product marketing does not establish support for every European allocation.

sources.locator: pp3-7 introduction, electrical specifications, full uplink/downlink table and mechanical drawing; pp9-12 test setups and measured curves; p53 changelog

limitations: Frequency/band coverage is a manufacturer reference result, not installed enclosure performance
Cable routing changes measured efficiency, gain and return loss; keep the exact assembly rather than shortening its cable
Page7 gives 90 mm while the introduction gives 90.4 mm; consumers should reserve at least 90400 um pending tolerance confirmation
No blanket per-band VSWR guarantee is inferred from product-page VSWR or marketing; p10 curves vary with frequency
ESD, DC isolation and host matching adaptation are not established by nominal 50 ohm impedance
Antenna gain, modem certification restrictions, enclosure fit, cable loss and LTE/GNSS/BLE coexistence need consumer review
Vendor PDF is cached for review only and excluded from redistributable production packages
